_comment: Known vulnerabilities in backend production dependencies. SHRINK ONLY — see scripts/check_dependency_audit.py. 24 → 17 → 4 → 1 on 2026-09-04. It cannot be cleared by bumping, so this file is at its floor until upstream ships something — do not read a non-empty baseline as neglect. ⚠ The recurring finding across all of these: requirements.txt had drifted BEHIND the desk environment, so the pins named versions nobody was testing against. Shrink BY NAME, never with --write, which re-records whatever the audit finds now.
